title: 忘却の墓標と、真鍮の月食譜
author: 神楽坂 探

en.title: The Monument of Oblivion and the Brass Lunar Eclipse Codex
en.premise: Ever since the day the city's true name was revealed to be the 'Monument of Oblivion,' the world has been trapped in a cycle of incomplete regenerations. One night, taking advantage of a momentary lapse in the information layers caused by a lunar eclipse, a 'corpse that should not physically exist' is discovered in a steam engine room within the power district. It is a grotesque entity, appearing as if composed of the fragmented memories of someone lost in the previous installment. Ren Kujo intuitively senses that this impossible death is a new 'typo' hidden within the city's reconstruction process.

zh.title: 遗忘的墓碑与黄铜月食谱
zh.premise: 自从那一天，城市的真名被揭示为“遗忘的墓碑”后，世界便陷入了不完全再生的循环之中。某夜，趁着月食导致信息层暂时中断的间隙，在动力区的蒸汽机房内，发现了一具“本不该在物理上存在的尸体”。那是一个扭曲的异形，仿佛是将前作中已然逝去之人的记忆碎片拼凑而成。九条莲直觉地感到，这场不可能的死亡，是隐藏在城市重构进程中的又一个全新的“错字”。

prediction_results.question: 異形の遺体が示した「構築の失敗」の正体とは？

朝比奈が遺体の持ち主だと判明
